title: Panel Discussion: Innovations in Technology and Project Design
gist: Stub page for a 27:57 Giga Africa 2026 panel (Benchmark's Caspar Rawles, BAC's Bill Williams, Managem's Intissar Benzakour) on technologies improving energy efficiency, sustainability and operating costs; the text holds only the session blurb and an agenda listing, with no substantive panel content.

insights.claim: A Giga Africa 2026 panel featuring Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, BAC and Managem is set to explore emerging technologies and innovations to improve energy efficiency, sustainability and long-term operating costs in battery materials projects.
